sloka: प्रक्षिव्य नरके सा त्वम् कैकेयि सुखिता भव ।मया रामेण च त्यक्तम् शाश्वतम् सत्कृतम् गुणैः ॥२-१२-९२॥
transliteration: prakṣivya narake sā tvam kaikeyi sukhitā bhava ।mayā rāmeṇa ca tyaktam śāśvatam satkṛtam guṇaiḥ ॥2-12-92॥

translations.english: You will rule undisturbed the Ikshvaku race honoured for its divine virtues. Now abandoned by me and Rama it will be afflicted with grief.
